title: Sebastian and the Bell
author: Wren Montrose
blurb: Coral Villalobos, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
